proofs.race_free: by refine ⟨finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()), ?_, ?_⟩; case refine_1 => rfl; case refine_2 => have h : (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())).trace = traceData := rfl; rw [h]; decide
proofs.segment_equivalence: by intro input outside; rw [segmentation_data]; refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩; case refine_1 => rfl; case refine_2 => have h : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := rfl; rw [h]; decide; case refine_3 => rfl
